% Canonical SCI-MAP v0.2 equations; inherited v0.1 equations plus the approved
% post-freeze coverage-cut disposition and bounded successor repairs through r0.4.
% Canonical equations. They are typeset in the scientist-facing view only.
\newcommand{\SCIMapObservationEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 a_{pi} &= G_{pi}\,\gamma_i,
 \label{eq:effective-coefficient}\\
 \mathcal G&=\{Z_{\rm avail},{\rm PTC}_{\rm ret},\gamma_{\rm avail},
 \gamma_{\rm QC},{\rm MAP}_{\rm adm},
 \nonumber\\[-2pt]
 &\hspace{2.4em}{\rm AST}_{\rm coord},Z_{\rm finite},\gamma_{>0},
 G_{\rm place},{\rm MAP}_{\rm local}\},
 \label{eq:contribution-gate-family}\\
 b_g(i,p)&=\operatorname{pass}_g\!\left(\sigma_g(i,p)\right)
 \in\{0,1\},\qquad g\in\mathcal G,
 \label{eq:typed-gate-projection}\\
 \operatorname{pass}_{\gamma,{\rm QC}}(i)&=
 \boldsymbol 1\!\left[\begin{gathered}
 \operatorname{request}_{\gamma,{\rm QC}}(i)=\texttt{requested},\\[-2pt]
 \operatorname{applicability}_{\gamma,{\rm QC}}(i)=\texttt{applicable},\\[-2pt]
 \operatorname{eligibility}_{\gamma,{\rm QC}}(i)=\texttt{eligible},\\[-2pt]
 \operatorname{realization}_{\gamma,{\rm QC}}(i)=\texttt{realized}
 \end{gathered}\right],
 \label{eq:gamma-qc-named-field-projection}\\
 \mathcal C_p&=\left\{i:\bigwedge_{g\in\mathcal G}b_g(i,p)=1\right\},
 \label{eq:contribution-set}\\
 \mathcal S_{\rm out}(\Pi_{\rm eff})
 &=\{p:\operatorname{authorize}_{\Pi_{\rm eff}}(p)=1\},
 \label{eq:support-authorized-row-set}\\
 N_p &= \sum_{i\in\mathcal C_p} a_{pi}z_i, &
 Q_p &= \sum_{i\in\mathcal C_p} a_{pi},
 \label{eq:ordinary-accumulators}\\
 K_p&=\sum_{i\in\mathcal C_p}a_{pi}k_i,
 \label{eq:response-accumulator}\\
 \widehat m_p &= N_p/Q_p, &
 \widehat k_p&=K_p/Q_p, \qquad p\in\mathcal S_{\rm out},
 \label{eq:ordinary-products}
\end{align}}

\newcommand{\SCIMapOperatorEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 D_Q&=\operatorname{diag}(G\Omega\boldsymbol 1),
 &J_{\rm out}\boldsymbol v&=(v_p)_{p\in\mathcal S_{\rm out}},
 &D_{Q,{\rm out}}&=J_{\rm out}D_QJ_{\rm out}^{\mathsf T},
 \label{eq:output-row-selection}\\
 A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}&\equiv A_{\rm out}
   \equiv D_{Q,{\rm out}}^{-1}J_{\rm out}G\Omega,
 &\widehat{\boldsymbol m}_{\rm out}&=A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}\boldsymbol z,
 \label{eq:map-operator}\\
 \delta\boldsymbol m_{\rm out}
   &=A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}H_{{\rm fixed},\Theta}\,\delta\boldsymbol s,
 &R_{{\rm fixed},\Theta}&=A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}H_{{\rm fixed},\Theta},
 &C_{m,{\rm out}}&=A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi} N_{\rm PTC}
                          A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}^{\mathsf T}.
 \label{eq:response-covariance}
\end{align}}

\newcommand{\SCIMapProcedureResponseEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 (\mathcal D^z_\Delta,\iota^z_0,\iota^z_+)
 &=\operatorname{authorize}_{\mathcal C_{\Delta z}}(z_0,z_+),
 \notag\\[-2pt]
 \Delta\boldsymbol z_{{\rm PTC}\text{-}{\rm FP}}(\delta\boldsymbol s;\alpha)
 &=\iota^z_+\mathcal P_{\rm PTC}(\boldsymbol s+\delta\boldsymbol s;\alpha)
   -\iota^z_0\mathcal P_{\rm PTC}(\boldsymbol s;\alpha),
 \label{eq:ptc-full-procedure-response}\\
 \Delta\mathcal S_{{\rm PTC}\text{-}{\rm FP}}
 &=\operatorname{state}_{\rm PTC}(\boldsymbol s+\delta\boldsymbol s;\alpha)
   \ominus\operatorname{state}_{\rm PTC}(\boldsymbol s;\alpha),
 \label{eq:ptc-full-procedure-state}\\
 (\mathcal D^m_\Delta,\iota^m_0,\iota^m_+)
 &=\operatorname{authorize}_{\mathcal C_{\Delta m}}(m_0,m_+),
 \notag\\[-2pt]
 \Delta\boldsymbol m_{{\rm PTC}\text{-}{\rm FP}}
 &=\iota^m_+A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}\boldsymbol z_+
   -\iota^m_0A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}\boldsymbol z_0,
 \quad\Pi\text{ fixed},
 \label{eq:map-of-ptc-full-procedure}\\
 \Delta\boldsymbol m_{{\rm PTC+MAP}\text{-}{\rm RR}}
 &=\iota^m_+\mathcal M\!\left(
   \mathcal P_{\rm PTC}(\boldsymbol s+\delta\boldsymbol s;\alpha);\Pi_{+}\right)
  -\iota^m_0\mathcal M\!\left(
   \mathcal P_{\rm PTC}(\boldsymbol s;\alpha);\Pi_{0}\right),
 \label{eq:ptc-map-reresolved-procedure-response}
\end{align}}

\newcommand{\SCIMapExposureEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 \mathcal U^{\rm up}_p
 &=\left\{u:e^{\rm vo}_u>0,\ G^{u}_{p}=1,\
   \exists i\in\mathcal I_{\rm route}:u\leadsto i\right\},
 \label{eq:upstream-original-population}\\
 E^{{\rm up},{\rm footprint}}_p
 &=\sum_{u\in\mathcal U^{\rm up}_p}e^{\rm vo}_u,
 \label{eq:original-exposure}\\
 \mathcal U^{\rm ret}_p
 &=\left\{u:e^{\rm vo}_u>0,\ G^{u}_{p}=1,\
   \exists i\in\mathcal C:u\leadsto i\right\},
 &E^{{\rm ret},{\rm footprint}}_p
 &=\sum_{u\in\mathcal U^{\rm ret}_p}e^{\rm vo}_u,
 \label{eq:retained-exposure}\\
 \mathcal U^c_p&=\bigcup_{o\in\mathcal O_p}\{(o,u):u\in\mathcal U^{\rm ret}_{op}\},
 &E^c_p&=\sum_{(o,u)\in\mathcal U^c_p}e^{\rm vo}_{ou}.
 \label{eq:coadd-exposure}
\end{align}}

\newcommand{\SCIMapFormalWeightEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 \operatorname{Var}(\widehat m_p\mid\Theta)
 &=\frac{\sum_iG_{pi}^{2}\gamma_i}
         {(\sum_iG_{pi}\gamma_i)^2},
 &
 \operatorname{Cov}(\widehat m_p,\widehat m_r\mid\Theta)
 &=\frac{\sum_iG_{pi}G_{ri}\gamma_i}{Q_pQ_r},
 \qquad p,r\in\mathcal S_{\rm out},
 \label{eq:fractional-covariance}\\
 \phi_p&=\frac{Q_p^2}{\sum_iG_{pi}^{2}\gamma_i},
 &
 \phi_p=Q_p&\Longleftrightarrow
 \sum_i\gamma_i(G_{pi}^{2}-G_{pi})=0,
 \qquad p\in\mathcal S_{\rm out},
 \label{eq:formal-weight}
\end{align}}

\newcommand{\SCIMapThresholdEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 \mathcal I_{\Pi_{\rm eff}}&=\text{the declared support-policy population},
 \label{eq:threshold-population-identity}\\
 \mathcal P&=\{Q_p:\operatorname{finite}(Q_p),\ Q_p>0,\
                     p\in\mathcal I_{\Pi_{\rm eff}}\},
 \label{eq:threshold-population}\\
 N&=|\mathcal P|, \qquad
 k=\left\lfloor\frac{\lfloor0.75N\rfloor+N}{2}\right\rfloor,
 \notag\\
 Q_\star&=\begin{cases}\mathcal P_{(k)},&N>0,\\0,&N=0,\end{cases}
 \label{eq:threshold-selector}\\
 (c_{\rm req},c_{\rm eff},c_{\rm obs},c_{\rm app},c_{\rm real})
 &=\text{requested, effective, observation-resolved, applied,} \notag\\
 &\quad\text{and realized exact states and values},
 \label{eq:coverage-cut-stages}\\
 \mathcal O_{>1}&=(I_{\rm request},I_{\rm authority},I_{\rm scope},
 c_{\rm req},c_{\rm eff},c_{\rm obs},c_{\rm app},c_{\rm real},
 \mathrm{cause},\mathrm{provenance}),
 \notag\\[-2pt]
 o_{>1}&=\operatorname{resolved\_boolean}(\mathcal O_{>1}),
 \label{eq:coverage-cut-override}\\
 \operatorname{admit}^{\rm pre}_{\Pi_{\rm eff}}(c_{\rm obs},o_{>1})&=
 \boldsymbol 1\!\left[\operatorname{finite}(c_{\rm obs}),\ c_{\rm obs}\ge0,\right.\notag\\
 &\qquad\left.c_{\rm obs}\le1\ \lor\ o_{>1}=\texttt{true}\right],
 \label{eq:coverage-cut-admission}\\
 c_{\rm app}&=c_{\rm obs}\quad\text{only at the bound support-policy
 application event},
 \notag\\[-2pt]
 c_{\rm real}&=c_{\rm app}\quad\text{only when an immutable realized output
 records that application},
 \label{eq:coverage-cut-application}\\
 T_{\rm norm}&=Q_\star c_{\rm app}/10,
 \qquad T_{\rm sci}=Q_\star c_{\rm app},
 \label{eq:support-thresholds}\\
 S_p^{\rm norm}&=\boldsymbol 1[\operatorname{finite}(Q_p),\ Q_p>0,\
                                  Q_p\ge T_{\rm norm}],
 \label{eq:normalization-support}\\
 S_p^{\rm sci}&=\boldsymbol 1[\operatorname{finite}(Q_p),\ Q_p>0,\
                                 Q_p\ge T_{\rm sci}].
 \label{eq:support-predicates}
\end{align}}

\newcommand{\SCIMapCoaddEquations}{%
\begin{align}
 \mathcal S^c_{\rm out}
 &=\{p:\operatorname{authorize}_{\Pi^c_{\rm eff}}(p)=1\},
 \label{eq:coadd-support-authorized-row-set}\\
 u_{op}&=1\quad\text{for each admitted observation row},
 \label{eq:coadd-uniform-coefficient}\\
 N^c_p&=\sum_{o\in\mathcal O_p}u_{op}\widehat m_{op},
 &Q^c_p&=\sum_{o\in\mathcal O_p}u_{op},
 \label{eq:coadd-accumulators}\\
 \widehat s_p&=N^c_p/Q^c_p, \qquad p\in\mathcal S^c_{\rm out},
 \label{eq:coadd-ordinary}\\
 J^c_{\rm out}\boldsymbol v^c&=(v^c_p)_{p\in\mathcal S^c_{\rm out}},
 \label{eq:coadd-output-row-selection}\\
 \widehat{\boldsymbol m}^{c}_{\rm out}
   &=(\widehat s_p)_{p\in\mathcal S^c_{\rm out}}
     =B_{\rm out}\widehat{\boldsymbol m}_{\rm obs},
 \label{eq:coadd-map-operator}\\
 \widehat k^{c,(R)}_p&=\frac{\sum_{o\in\mathcal O_p}u_{op}\widehat k^{(R)}_{op}}{Q^c_p},
 \qquad p\in\mathcal S^c_{\rm out}.
 \label{eq:coadd-response-product}\\
 C_{c,{\rm out}}&=B_{\rm out}\boldsymbol\Sigma^{\rm obs}B_{\rm out}^{\mathsf T}
 \quad\text{only when every required block is available},
 \label{eq:coadd-covariance}\\
 T_{\rm obs}^{(R)}&=\operatorname{ordered\_stack}_{o}\!\left(R_o^{(R)}\right),
 \notag\\
 R_{{\rm coadd,out}}^{(R)}&=B_{\rm out}T_{\rm obs}^{(R)},
 \notag\\[-2pt]
 &\quad\text{only under the exact compatible fixed coadd state}.
 \label{eq:coadd-companions}
\end{align}}
